top_stories.title: Oktane 2026 Recap: Okta Announces A Unified IAM Control Plane, With Agent Governance And Identity Details Remaining Unclear
top_stories.summary: At Oktane 2026 in Las Vegas, Okta announced plans to transform its platform into a unified IAM control plane with capabilities for AI agent governance. Details around agent identity and governance implementation remain unclear following the conference announcements.

top_stories.title: Dual NetScaler Zero-Days Trigger Chaos for Citrix Customers
top_stories.summary: Citrix disclosed two critical zero-day vulnerabilities in its NetScaler products that affect default configurations and allow attackers unauthorized access to customer networks. The flaws function as authentication bypasses, effectively granting attackers a skeleton key to compromise network access controls.

top_stories.title: AI Agents Are Privileged Users; Who Is Auditing Their Access?
top_stories.summary: The article examines AI agents operating with broad privileged access within enterprise environments, framing them as a new category of privileged users that fall outside traditional PAM and access governance controls. The piece raises concerns about the lack of auditing and oversight applied to autonomous AI agents compared to human users, directly implicating IAM and PAM frameworks.

top_stories.title: JadePuffer AI Actor Compromises Azure Tenant in Destructive Cloud Attack
top_stories.summary: A threat actor dubbed "JadePuffer" compromised an Azure tenant in a destructive cloud attack, deleting cloud-based storage, applications, and databases. The actor reportedly used exposed credentials to gain access, highlighting risks around credential management and cloud identity security in Microsoft Azure environments.

top_stories.title: The Day-One Hole in Zero Trust Architecture
top_stories.summary: Specops published an analysis identifying a structural vulnerability in Zero Trust architecture during the user onboarding phase, before credentials and MFA methods are established. The piece argues that identity verification must occur prior to issuing credentials, MFA, and access rights to close the trust gap that exists before strong authentication is in place.

news.title: Kiteworks & Citrix Incidents Show Challenges of Zero-Day Response
news.summary: Kiteworks and Citrix faced separate zero-day security incidents requiring emergency response measures, with Kiteworks instructing customers to power down its platform during a nine-hour window. Citrix did not communicate with customers about reported attacks prior to releasing a patch, highlighting differing vendor disclosure practices in zero-day response scenarios.

news.title: SWIFT Banking & Government Middleware Enables RCE
news.summary: A vulnerability in SWIFT banking and government middleware has been identified that enables remote code execution (RCE). The flaw can be exploited to bypass hardware-based MFA in high-security environments, making patching urgent for affected organizations.

news.title: Chinese spies impersonate White House, Anthropic figures to phish AI policy experts
news.summary: A China-aligned espionage group tracked as TA419 conducted credential phishing campaigns in July 2026, impersonating a former White House OSTP official and a prominent economist to access cloud accounts of AI policy experts. Proofpoint researchers identified the campaigns, which targeted victims' cloud account credentials through identity impersonation tactics.

news.title: Criminal recruiters want people on your payroll
news.summary: Intel 471's "Insiders for Hire" report details how cybercriminals are actively recruiting employees at specific organizations to exploit their legitimate access for criminal purposes. The report covers underground markets where insiders sell access-related services including account resets, transaction approvals, and information lookups to criminal customers.

news.title: AI agents keep access to company data after their work is done
news.summary: Delinea's 2026 Identity Security Report: The AI Enforcement Gap found that IT teams are concerned about AI agents retaining persistent access to company systems after completing tasks. The report highlights a gap between written AI access policies and the ability to enforce them in real time when AI agents act on users' behalf.

news.title: Dell CSM Flaws Enable Unauthenticated Admin Access and Root on Kubernetes Nodes
news.summary: Dell has released security updates addressing critical vulnerabilities in Dell Container Storage Modules (CSM), including CVE-2026-63688 (CVSS 10.0), a missing authentication flaw in the csm-authorization-storage gRPC server. The vulnerability enables unauthenticated administrative access and root-level compromise on Kubernetes nodes, directly affecting Dell's CSM authorization component.

news.title: Why CISOs Struggle to Answer the Board's Three Hardest Questions, and How to Fix the Report
news.summary: The article addresses the challenge CISOs face when reporting security posture to boards, with identity provider data being one of several sources used to compile reports. The content is primarily focused on board communication and security reporting strategy rather than IAM-specific technology or practice.

news.title: Microsoft enables Windows settings backup by default for orgs
news.summary: Microsoft has enabled Windows settings backup and restore by default on enterprise systems joined to Microsoft Entra (both standard and hybrid) when upgraded to Windows 11 26H2. This change affects how organizational device configurations are stored and synchronized through Microsoft Entra-joined environments.

news.title: CISA Adds Exploited Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Auth Bypass to KEV
news.summary: CISA added a critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (CVE-2026-76504, CVSS 9.8) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following confirmed active exploitation. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access affected systems, representing a direct authentication control failure in network management infrastructure.

news.title: Citrix NetScaler Post-Exploitation Payload Creates Superuser, Maps Web Shell to CSS-Like URLs
news.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a critical pre-authentication command injection vulnerability in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway to deploy web shells and steal configuration data. The attacks, analyzed by LevelBlue's THOR team across multiple customer environments, involve creating superuser accounts and mapping web shells to CSS-like URLs to evade detection.

news.title: Ditto Named a Product Leader in KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity Verification
news.summary: Ditto has been named a Product Leader in the KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity Verification. The recognition highlights Ditto's approach to binding verified identity to high-assurance authentication and its no-code orchestration layer.

news.title: Keeper Security Freshservice Workflow App Streamlines Vault and Privileged Access Request Process
news.summary: Keeper Security has launched a new integration with Freshservice that allows IT and security teams to search the Keeper vault and submit privileged access requests directly from the Freshservice ticket sidebar. The integration combines Keeper's zero-trust, zero-knowledge PAM capabilities with Freshservice's IT service management workflow.

news.title: From Shadow AI to Accountable Agents: Why Agent Governance Needs Enforcement
news.summary: The article addresses the emerging challenge of governing AI agents within enterprise identity governance frameworks, arguing that traditional static IAM models are insufficient for managing autonomous AI systems. The piece focuses on the need for continuous monitoring and dynamic risk management as AI agents proliferate and operate with delegated access across enterprise environments.

news.title: Attackers Exploit Zimbra Flaw to Deploy Web Shells and Harvest Authentication Secrets
news.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a critical Zimbra Collaboration Suite vulnerability (CVE-2026-73570, CVSS 8.9) to deploy web shells and harvest authentication secrets from mailboxes. The flaw is an unauthenticated OS command injection vulnerability enabling remote code execution via SNMP, discovered by Microsoft Security Research.

news.title: Cisco Warns of Attackers Exploiting Critical Authentication Bypass in SD-WAN Manager
news.summary: Cisco disclosed an actively exploited critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-76504) in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access the system's API with admin privileges. Fixed releases are available, and no workaround exists for the flaw.

news.title: Know Your Enemy: Browser-Based Attack Techniques in 2026
news.summary: An article outlines six browser-based attack techniques relevant to security teams in 2026, noting that most breaches today originate and occur entirely within browser sessions. The piece focuses on browser as an attack surface but does not specifically address IAM controls, authentication mechanisms, or identity-specific defenses.

news.title: US-Focused CSuite Phishing Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions and Deploys RMM Tools for Remote Access
news.summary: Researchers at ANY.RUN identified a phishing campaign called CSuite targeting Microsoft 365 users, traced across 351 sandbox analyses with 51% of submissions from the US. The campaign combines Microsoft 365 session token theft with deployment of remote management tools to enable persistent access and broader account compromise across technology, manufacturing, government, and consulting sectors.

news.title: keycloak v26.7.5
news.summary: Keycloak has released version 26.7.5 of its open source identity and access management platform. The release applies to Keycloak's IAM solution designed for modern applications and services.

news.title: CEO Interview: Oak
news.summary: Oak CEO Shai Ben-Zion Morag gave an interview to CB Insights discussing the company's positioning in the identity governance market. The interview covers Oak's view of customer needs and where the company fits within the identity governance space.

news.title: Britive Launches Frictionless PAM Transformation Program to Modernize Privileged Access for the Autonomous Era
news.summary: Britive has launched a Frictionless PAM Transformation Program aimed at helping enterprises modernize their Privileged Access Management infrastructure. The program targets migration from traditional PAM environments to a model designed to support AI agents, non-human identities, and cloud-native operations.

news.title: AI's Third Wave: Coworkers Break the Security Model That Worked for Agents
news.summary: Token Security has published analysis arguing that persistent AI "coworker" systems require dedicated identity management approaches distinct from those used for traditional AI agents, citing risks from continuous operation with standing access. The piece outlines requirements including individual identities, defined owners, scoped permissions, and lifecycle management for these AI entities.

news.title: Microsoft to block Entra ID script injection attacks starting October
news.summary: Microsoft will implement enhanced protections against external script injection attacks in its Entra ID authentication system starting in October. The update targets a specific attack vector affecting the Entra ID platform and was announced as a reminder to customers to prepare for the change.

news.title: Security Uses Cryptography in Pieces. WinMagic Says That Gap Is What AI Attacks.
news.summary: WinMagic CEO Thi Nguyen-Huu argues that AI-enabled attacks exploit gaps between disparate cryptographic components in security systems. He advocates for reducing user-dependent security decisions and tying authentication more closely to the protected session that follows.

news.title: Five MCP Authentication Mechanisms Shipped in Two Weeks – the Pattern
news.summary: Five distinct and non-interoperable authentication mechanisms for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) were shipped within a two-week window in late September, developed independently without coordination. The fragmented rollout highlights emerging authentication challenges in AI tool integration protocols relevant to IAM architects evaluating agentic AI security.

news.title: NTT TechnoCross Receives Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Japanese Company of the Year Recognition for Privileged Access Management Leadership for the Third Consecutive Year
news.summary: NTT TechnoCross has received Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Japanese Company of the Year award for privileged access management for the third consecutive year. The recognition highlights the company's unified governance approach, cloud-ready security offerings, and innovation in Japan's PAM market.

news.title: French Tax Data Theft Using Stolen Staff Passwords Went Undetected for Seven Weeks
news.summary: An attacker used stolen staff credentials to exfiltrate tax data on hundreds of thousands of French taxpayers and businesses from France's tax administration, going undetected for seven weeks. France's national cybersecurity agency ANSSI attributed the successful breach to weak security controls rather than sophisticated attack techniques.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million U.S. and Canadian driver's licenses, allegedly sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has launched an official inquiry into the breach, which affects a widely-used identity verification provider.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in theft of AT&T call and text records belonging to over 100 million customers.
